result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back from all six lookups you listed. I didn't add a test for the new description. The existing suite (`mvn -q -o test`) passes.

- **`schema.sql`**: added a nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column to `promotion`. Older promotions simply have none.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added `description` as the last record component. I kept a 6-argument constructor that sets it to null, so the roughly 50 existing callers and tests compile unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` now stores the description. The code lookup, active-on-date, active-in-region, by-category, best-for-category and unused-in-period queries now select and map it.
- **`PromotionService.java`**: added a `createPromotion(..., category, description)` overload; a blank description is stored as none. The old 5-argument method still works and creates a promotion with no description.
